diagnosis: The fleet tracking endpoint queries live GPS positions stored in a Faust stream table using fleet_id from the path. It confirms the caller is an authenticated fleet operator, but omits verifying that current_operator.fleet_id equals fleet_id, allowing operators to monitor live locations of delivery vehicles belonging to competing fleets.
exploit_request:
GET /tracking/fleets/fleet_courier_express_ny/active-locations HTTP/1.1
Host: dispatch.logistics-fleet.net
Authorization: Bearer <competitor_operator_jwt>
